newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Sammi Steel, Sammi Corp resume trading.
newsitem.headline: Sammi Steel, Sammi Corp resume trading.

text.p: Shares of insolvent Sammi Steel and Sammi Corp resumed trading on Friday, after having been placed on the Korea Stock Exchange's supervision list, an exchange statement said.

The statement said the exchange set the base price for Sammi Steel and Sammi Corp at 2,970 won and 1,500 won respectively. Their price movement will be limited within a 250 won and 120 won range respectively.
The exchange suspended trading in those stocks on Tuesday as the two companies filed for court receivership. Sammi Steel stood at 3,220 won and Sammi Corp at 1,620 won before trading was halted.
